---
title: "Indirect effect of influenza vaccination coverage on the circulation of respiratory viruses"   
subtitle: "Pre-COVID-19 period (2016–2019): Supplementary Figs.S16"
output: html_document
---
If necessary, we can clear the environment to start with a clean workspace.
```{r}
rm(list=ls())
source("01_load_package.R")
source("02_plot_theme.R")
out_path1 <- "02_output/FigS16_pre"
dir.create(out_path1)
```

## Prepare data for influenza scenario exploration analysis
```{r}
data_country_plot0 <- read.csv("01_data/multi_vaccine_indirect_precovid19.csv")
data_country_plot <- data_country_plot0[,c("country","year","month","year_decimal","ISOYM",
                                "virus","AAP","fluA_AAP", "fluB_AAP", "flu_AAP","strategy2_general_coverage")]
colnames(data_country_plot)[8:11] <- c("INF_A","INF_B","INF_ALL","Vaccine")
dat_vero_avg<- read.csv(paste0("01_data","/seasonal_flu_coverage_average.csv"))
colnames(dat_vero_avg)[4] <- "general_coverage"

low_country <- unique(subset(dat_vero_avg, general_coverage < 10)$country)
high_country <- unique(subset(dat_vero_avg, general_coverage > 30)$country)
```


## Prepare influenza scenario exploration results
```{r eval=FALSE}
if (FALSE) {
folder_path <- "02_output/02_CCM/03_mul_CCM/02_mul_smap_country_result"
csv_files <- list.files(path = folder_path, pattern =  "flu_.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
data_list <- lapply(csv_files, read.csv)

se_pred.flu <- do.call(rbind, data_list)
se_pred.flu$virus <- sub(",.*", "", se_pred.flu$mul_type)  
se_pred.flu$flu_type <-  sapply(strsplit(se_pred.flu$mul_type, ", "), function(x) x[2])

# Save influenza scenario exploration results
saveRDS(se_pred.flu, "02_output/Influenza_scenario_preCOVID.rds", compress = "xz")
}
```

## Load precomputed influenza scenario exploration results
```{r fig.width=17, fig.height=3.6, dpi=300}
se_pred.flu <- readRDS("02_output/Influenza_scenario_preCOVID.rds")
```


## Prepare IAV scenario exploration results by vaccination coverage group
```{r fig.width=17, fig.height=3.6, dpi=300}

plot.SE.flu <- data_country_plot %>%
  inner_join(se_pred.flu, by = c("year_decimal","country","virus")) %>%
  mutate(delta = delta)

plot.SE.flu_a <- subset(plot.SE.flu, flu_type == "INF_A")

plot.SE.flu_a <- plot.SE.flu_a %>%
  mutate(region_type = case_when(
    country %in% high_country ~ "High coverage region",
    country %in% low_country ~ "Low coverage region",
    TRUE ~ "Medium coverage region"
  ))

plot.SE.flu_a_rsv <- subset(plot.SE.flu_a, virus == "RSV")
plot.SE.flu_a_piv <- subset(plot.SE.flu_a, virus == "PIV")
plot.SE.flu_a_hmpv <- subset(plot.SE.flu_a, virus == "HMPV")
plot.SE.flu_a_rv <- subset(plot.SE.flu_a, virus == "RV")
plot.SE.flu_a_adv <- subset(plot.SE.flu_a, virus == "ADV")

colors <- c("#377eb8",'#7570b3', "#dc3637","#cc2b80","#77488c","#EA2027","#45aaf2","#504190","#2f9798","#88b5d6","#d4b9da")
```

## Supplementary Fig. S16A: Pre-COVID-19 (IAV)
```{r fig.width=17, fig.height=3.6, dpi=300}
p_fluA_rsv <-plot.SE.flu_a_rsv %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Vaccine, y = delta)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 0, intercept = 0, color = 'black', lwd = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(color =region_type,fill =region_type),shape = 21, size=3.5, alpha = 1,color="gray",na.rm = T) +
  geom_quantile(quantiles = 0.05, size = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_quantile(quantiles = 0.95, size = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", na.rm = TRUE)+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 30, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60",size=1.5) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim =c(-1,1.02))+
  facet_wrap(~virus, scales = "free_x", nrow = 2) + 
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Effect of IAV on RSV\n(\u0394RSV/\u0394IAV)",labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.1),
                     limits = c(-1.7,1.02),breaks = seq(-1.5, 1, 0.5)) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "AIVC", breaks = seq(0,80, 20)) +
  labs(y = NULL,color = "", fill = "",title = "") +
  mytheme +
  theme(axis.title.y.left = element_text(margin = margin(0,-0.1,0,0,'cm')),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(0.1,0,0,0,'cm')))+
  scale_fill_manual("",values =  colors,breaks = c("Low coverage region",
                                                   "Medium coverage region",
                                                   "High coverage region"))+
   theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 20),legend.position = "bottom",panel.grid.major.x=element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y=element_blank(), strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = "black", size = 0.5))
#p_fluA_rsv
```

## Supplementary Fig. S16C: Pre-COVID-19 (IBV)
```{r fig.width=17, fig.height=3.6, dpi=300}
p_fluB_rsv <-plot.SE.flu_b_rsv %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Vaccine, y = delta)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 0, intercept = 0, color = 'black', lwd = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(color =region_type,fill =region_type),shape = 21, size=3.5, alpha = 1,color="gray",na.rm = T) +
  geom_quantile(quantiles = 0.05, size = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_quantile(quantiles = 0.95, size = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", na.rm = TRUE)+
  coord_cartesian(ylim =c(-1.5,1.04))+
  facet_wrap(~virus, scales = "free_x", nrow = 2) + 
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Effect of IBV on RSV\n(\u0394RSV/\u0394IBV)",labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.1),
                     limits = c(-1.5,1.04),breaks = seq(-1.5, 1, 0.5)) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "AIVC", breaks = seq(0,80, 20)) +
  labs(y = NULL,color = "", fill = "",title = "") +
  mytheme +
  theme(axis.title.y.left = element_text(margin = margin(0,-0.1,0,0,'cm')),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(0.1,0,0,0,'cm')))+
  scale_fill_manual("",values =  colors,breaks = c("Low coverage region",
                                                   "Medium coverage region",
                                                   "High coverage region"))+
   theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 20),legend.position = "bottom",panel.grid.major.x=element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y=element_blank(), strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = "black", size = 0.5))
#p_fluB_rsv
```
